Frequently asked questions. If your question isn't answered here, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/pirl-unc/exacto/issues).

<script>
function faqExpandAll() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#faq-list .callout-collapse:not(.show)').forEach(c => {
    bootstrap.Collapse.getOrCreateInstance(c, {toggle: false}).show();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#faq-list details').forEach(d => { d.open = true; });
}
function faqCollapseAll() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#faq-list .callout-collapse.show').forEach(c => {
    bootstrap.Collapse.getOrCreateInstance(c, {toggle: false}).hide();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#faq-list details').forEach(d => { d.open = false; });
}
</script>

<div class="d-flex gap-2 my-3">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="faqExpandAll()">Expand all</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="faqCollapseAll()">Collapse all</button>
</div>

**Inputs**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" icon="false"}
## For `integrate-vars` can I supply a DNA variant callset from another method?

Yes, but the variant callset format must be in the Occam's Grammar format (TSV). You can do this using
[VSTOL](https://github.com/pirl-unc/vstol).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" icon="false"}
## How do I avoid out-of-memory errors on large BAMs?

Exacto's DNA variant caller (`call-dna-vars`) holds per-read evidence in memory while
clustering variant candidates. If your Exacto job runs out of memory, you can:

- Reduce `--num-threads` to lower concurrent peak memory.
- Reduce `--chunk-size` (default: 100,000) for `call-dna-vars`.
:::
